My initial thoughts:

Aesthetics: The map looks and feels better now. It feels more like a city and less like a playground for mechs. In particular, I think the new roads help to establish a better sense of scale. I would have liked some taller buildings to help reinforce that sense of scale. It also would have been great to have some more details to make the city seem more "lived in" (for example something to indicate the purpose of the platform by the river in E5; maybe some benches, ruined kiosks, wrecked cars, something).

Gameplay: I like the increased density of the map. I think the additional cover will allow greater freedom to maneuver and will hopefully lead to more dynamics games. I hope that there will be a good amount of fighting on the expanded edges of the map, rather than just in the middle, but I guess that remains to be seen.
